title: Railway Atlas synthetic client baseline

environment.gpu: SwiftShader software rendering; flags inherited from scripts/browser.mjs
environment.network_isolation: Existing public ORM guard + fixture routes; no fallback Node fetch; browser DNS disallowed except loopback; background networking disabled

fixture_coverage: One Wuhan railway line; representative synthetic signals/crossings/street-running indexes and gzip MVTs; empty branch index and frequency manifest. Real pinned MapLibre and PMTiles clients. 217-byte PMTiles v3 archive: one empty 14-byte z0 water MVT, no higher zoom tiles. Limited synthetic coverage, not world data density.
qualifications: Synthetic local data only; no production timing, live upstream cost or optimization claim.
Cold: fresh browser/context; OS cache was not flushed. Warm: repeat navigation in same browser/context.
Playwright routing disabled HTTP cache in both cases; warm HTTP-cache performance unavailable.
Three first-party worker responses per startup have unmeasured encoded/body byte sizes; one blob worker also lacks byte measurements. Startup totals are known-byte lower bounds.
Encoded response counters are CDP counters including protocol overhead, not wire-transfer measurement; decoded HTTP body bytes can still contain application gzip.
Process RSS is summed across processes, potentially double-counting shared pages; not unique or peak memory.
All external/provider requests fulfilled locally; zero upstream delivery. Zero observed blocked/failure events does not provide unobserved worker final status.
TaskDuration is task duration, not separately measured thread CPU. Aggregate process CPU is available.
Two repeats per case are a bounded descriptive baseline; software rendering and host contention limit interpretation.
preservation: Requested files copied byte-for-byte after SHA-256 validation. No measurement rerun, source change, credentials, signed transfer URLs, private task notes, or unrelated files included.
